name: Duplicate
source:
At the moment when there is not enough oxygen in the lungs, the body is enveloped in cold, and a fire of heated thoughts is raging in the head, the only thing that remains is the desire to free one's life from the pressure of fate.

You wake up inside a capsule that surrounds you from all sides, envelopes you, preventing you from breathing, like a freshly buried coffin. Rejecting disturbing thoughts and igniting the will to freedom seems to be the only way out of this deadly trap.

Through the game, you will need to re-learn this world, its laws, features, as well as people who may turn out to be a real surprise. You will have to determine how to move forward with your life. And is it yours... that life...? Why did you end up in that capsule? What is this place? Who closed you there, or maybe you yourself?

Who are you really?

[Translated from [url=https://korokip.itch.io/duplicate42]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当肺部氧气不足，身体被寒冷笼罩，头脑中熊熊燃烧着炽热的思绪之火时，唯一剩下的就是将自己的生命从命运的压力中解脱出来的渴望。

你在一个胶囊中醒来，它从四面八方包围着你，包围着你，让你无法呼吸，就像一口刚埋葬的棺材一样。拒绝令人不安的想法并点燃自由意志似乎是摆脱这个致命陷阱的唯一出路。

通过游戏，你将需要重新了解这个世界，它的法则、特征，以及那些可能会带来真正惊喜的人。你必须决定如何继续你的生活。那生命……是你的吗？你为什么会被困在那个太空舱里？这是什么地方？谁把你关在那里，或者也许是你自己？

你到底是谁？
